description: This file defines the 'GeneralPlatformDomainRuleException' class, a custom exception extending 'AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException', used to indicate violations of domain rules in the application.

classes.name: GeneralPlatformDomainRuleException
classes.description: A final class representing a runtime exception for domain rule violations.

methods.name: GeneralPlatformDomainRuleException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with message codes and arguments by calling the superclass constructor.
